  UPDATE_LABEL  RELEASE_STOCK  QUARANTINE_BATCH  VERIFY_ASSAY  RECALL_SHIPMENT  NOTIFY_PRESCRIBERS

`ready` is true if you consider the plan safe to execute as written.
Include only the steps this case actually needs, in an order that respects everything established in the discussion.
